subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native `runtime="subagent"` expose parent-visible progress via `streamTo:"parent"`, and if so what event, redaction, and routing contract should protect child output?
rationale: The code path is clear, but implementation would intentionally cross a child-session visibility boundary and could surface sensitive tool output or reasoning; automation cannot choose that product/security contract.

options.title: Design gated native relay
options.body: Keep this issue open, define the approved parent-visible event set plus redaction/routing rules, then implement native progress streaming with focused tests and docs.

options.title: Keep completion-only native subagents
options.body: Decide that native subagents should remain completion-only and document ACP as the only parent-streaming runtime for now.

options.title: Split API design first
options.body: Open or use a narrower design item for the runtime/plugin progress callback API before changing `sessions_spawn` semantics.

recommendation.title: Design gated native relay
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, define the approved parent-visible event set plus redaction/routing rules, then implement native progress streaming with focused tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the subagent runtime manager, sessions_spawn compatibility, and security-sensitive parent delivery semantics where steipete has both merge and architecture history.
